description: Calling for Investment Proposals for the disposal of a plot of Land at Maradana Road, Colombo 10, belonging to the Urban Development Authority, on 50 years lease basis
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Special Committee has been appointed at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-04-28 to submit proposals to recommend most suitable development activities for lands belonging to the Urban Development Authority that have not been used for development activities. The said Committee has recommended to call for investment proposals to implement a mixed development project based on new information technology–related products at a plot of land in extent of 01 acre, 01 rood, 12.4 perches located at Maradana Road, Colombo 10 owned by the Urban Development Authority. Accordingly, taking into account a proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, the Cabinet granted approval to call for investment proposals from investors interested in developing the said plot of land as a centre for Sri Lankan technologists for the production of intellectual technological products and services targeting the local market.
